skill_name: Analyze how data analysis can help to optimize production processes in a business.
workflow: Data analysis can be a powerful tool in optimizing production processes in a business. By collecting and analyzing data, businesses can identify inefficiencies, areas for improvement, and unexpected patterns in their production and supply chain systems. For example, data analysis can lead to more efficient scheduling of production and help identify waste within different processes.
